_about: Every figure that changes. Lessons show these with {{fig:key}}. Update 'value', 'display', 'asOf' and 'checked' together. See UPDATING.md.

bankRate.label: Bank Rate
bankRate.asOf: held on 17 September 2026; next decision 5 November 2026
bankRate.refresh: after every Bank of England decision

topEasyAccess.label: Top easy-access savings rates
topEasyAccess.asOf: late October 2026; several only with a temporary bonus
topEasyAccess.refresh: after every Bank of England decision

cardApr.label: Average advertised credit card purchase APR

personalAllowance.label: Personal Allowance
personalAllowance.asOf: 2026/27 tax year; shrinks by £1 for every £2 of income over £100,000

niEmployee.label: Employee National Insurance
niEmployee.asOf: 2026/27: 8% on pay between £12,570 and £50,270 a year, 2% above

nmwApprentice.label: Apprentice rate
nmwApprentice.asOf: from 1 April 2026: apprentices under 19, or 19+ in their first year

tradingAllowance.label: Trading allowance
tradingAllowance.asOf: a year, unchanged since April 2017; the point you must report rises to £3,000 from 2027/28 (announced)

psa.label: Personal Savings Allowance
psa.asOf: 2026/27, basic-rate taxpayers (£500 higher-rate, £0 additional-rate); savings tax rates rise 2 points from 6 April 2027 (announced in Budget 2025)

startingRateSavings.label: Starting rate for savings
startingRateSavings.asOf: 2026/27; shrinks by £1 for each £1 of other income over £12,570

cashIsaCap2027.label: Cash ISA limit for under-65s
cashIsaCap2027.asOf: from 6 April 2027 (announced in Budget 2025; the £20,000 total stays; final rules still to be laid)
cashIsaCap2027.source: providers' summaries (e.g. Close Brothers Savings); check gov.uk

lisaLimit.label: Lifetime ISA yearly limit
lisaLimit.asOf: 2026/27; open at 18 to 39, pay in until 50, 25% government bonus up to £1,000 a year

lisaHomeCap.label: Lifetime ISA first-home price limit
lisaHomeCap.asOf: October 2026; a 25% charge applies to other withdrawals before 60

fscs.label: FSCS deposit protection
fscs.asOf: per person, per banking licence, from 1 December 2025 (was £85,000)

statePension.label: Full new State Pension
statePension.asOf: 2026/27, about £12,548 a year; needs 35 qualifying years of National Insurance

statePensionAge.label: State Pension age
statePensionAge.asOf: legislated timetable; the rise to 68 is currently due 2044 to 2046 and is under review

aeTrigger.label: Auto-enrolment earnings trigger
aeTrigger.asOf: 2026/27 (unchanged); applies from age 22 to State Pension age

aeBand.label: Qualifying earnings band
aeBand.asOf: 2026/27 (unchanged); minimum contributions are a share of pay in this band

aeMinimum.display: 8% in total, at least 3% from the employer
aeMinimum.label: Auto-enrolment minimum contributions

annualAllowance.label: Pension annual allowance
annualAllowance.asOf: 2026/27; lower for very high earners and after taking pension money flexibly

plan2.label: Student loan Plan 2 threshold
plan2.asOf: 2026/27; you repay 9% of pay above it

plan5.label: Student loan Plan 5 threshold
plan5.asOf: 2026/27; you repay 9% of pay above it (courses in England from August 2023)

postgradLoan.label: Postgraduate loan threshold
postgradLoan.asOf: 2026/27; you repay 6% of pay above it

plan5Interest.label: Plan 5 interest rate
plan5Interest.asOf: 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027 (RPI); Plan 2 is RPI to RPI + 3%, capped at 6% for the year

maintenanceLoan.label: Maximum maintenance loan away from home, outside London
maintenanceLoan.asOf: 2026/27, England (£9,118 living at home, £14,135 in London; less for higher household incomes)

energyCap.label: Energy price cap, typical dual-fuel home
energyCap.asOf: 1 October to 31 December 2026, paying by Direct Debit

bnplRules.label: Buy now, pay later brought under FCA rules
bnplRules.asOf: lenders must now check affordability; complaints can go to the Financial Ombudsman

overdraftEar.label: Typical arranged overdraft rate at big banks
overdraftEar.asOf: 2026; some app banks charge 15–39% depending on your credit record
overdraftEar.source: Pocketwise round-up of bank rates (one source)

emergencyFund.display: three to six months of essential costs
emergencyFund.label: Emergency fund guide

lisaReplacement.display: a new First Time Buyer ISA
lisaReplacement.label: Planned Lifetime ISA replacement
lisaReplacement.asOf: consultation launched 23 June 2026; launch possibly April 2028 and not yet law; existing Lifetime ISA holders are expected to keep paying in

pensionAccessAge.label: Earliest age you can usually take a private or workplace pension
pensionAccessAge.asOf: normal minimum pension age, legislated; most people can take 25% of their pot tax-free

dividendAllowance.label: Dividend allowance
dividendAllowance.asOf: 2026/27; above it, dividends are taxed at 10.75% (basic rate), 35.75% (higher) or 39.35% (additional)

cgtAllowance.label: Capital Gains Tax allowance
cgtAllowance.asOf: 2026/27; gains above it taxed at 18% (within the basic-rate band) or 24%

stampDutyShares.label: Stamp Duty on buying UK shares
stampDutyShares.asOf: Stamp Duty Reserve Tax on most UK company shares; not charged on buying units in UK funds from the fund manager

usLongRun.display: about 6.6% a year above inflation (shares) against about 1.6% (government bonds)
usLongRun.label: Long-run US real returns
usLongRun.asOf: 1900 to 2025; worked out from UBS's figures ($1 grew to $124,854 in shares and $284 in long bonds, with inflation averaging 2.9% a year)
usLongRun.source: UBS Global Investment Returns Yearbook 2026 (summary); WealthBriefing

activeVsPassive.label: Active funds beating a tracker over 10 years
activeVsPassive.asOf: across seven equity sectors, to mid-2025; S&P's SPIVA found 97% of European active equity funds lagged their benchmark over 10 years to end-2025
activeVsPassive.source: AJ Bell Manager versus Machine (July 2025); S&P SPIVA Europe (via Indexology blog)

trackerOcf.label: Ongoing charge of index trackers
trackerOcf.asOf: examples include FTSE All-Share trackers at 0.06%; active funds average about 0.9–1%
trackerOcf.source: Money Observer and City AM (FE fund data)

ftse2008.label: FTSE 100 fall in the financial crisis
ftse2008.asOf: from its 2007 high to 3,512 on 3 March 2009

ftse2020.label: FTSE 100 fall, first quarter of 2020
ftse2020.asOf: 1 January to 31 March 2020 (Covid crash); the index ended 2020 down 14.3%

behaviourGap.label: Investors' returns vs their funds' returns
behaviourGap.asOf: US funds, 10 years to end-2024 (funds 8.2% a year, investors 7.0%); the 2026 study found 9.9% vs 8.7%
behaviourGap.source: Morningstar Mind the Gap (reported by Boldin and WealthManagement.com)

cfdLossRate.label: Retail CFD accounts that lose money
cfdLossRate.asOf: big UK providers' required risk warnings, 2026 (average about 70% across 14 FCA-authorised brokers, April 2026)
cfdLossRate.source: providers' FCA risk warnings, compiled by The Investors Centre and Pound Sterling Live

cfdLeverage.label: Maximum leverage for retail CFDs and spread bets
cfdLeverage.asOf: FCA rules since 2019 (30:1 on major currency pairs down to 5:1 on individual shares); positions are closed when funds fall to 50% of the margin needed; you can't lose more than your account

cryptoRules.label: Crypto derivatives (CFDs, futures, options) for retail customers
cryptoRules.asOf: crypto exchange-traded notes on UK exchanges allowed for retail from 8 October 2025, with no FSCS cover; buying crypto itself is mostly unregulated

dayTraders.label: Day traders who kept going for 300+ days and lost money
dayTraders.asOf: all individuals who started day trading Brazilian equity futures in 2013–2015; only 0.4% earned more than a bank teller's wage
dayTraders.source: Chague, De-Losso and Giovannetti, "Day Trading for a Living?" (FGV)

spreadBetTax.display: usually free of Capital Gains Tax
spreadBetTax.label: Spread betting tax
spreadBetTax.asOf: HMRC treats it as gambling, so losses can't offset gains; CFD profits are taxed as capital gains above the £3,000 allowance
spreadBetTax.source: providers' tax guides (IG, CMC Markets); check HMRC

ukFinanceSize.display: about 9% of UK economic output and about 1.2 million jobs
ukFinanceSize.label: Size of UK financial services
ukFinanceSize.asOf: government figures, July 2025 (about 11% and 2.5 million jobs if related professional services such as law and accounting are included, TheCityUK 2026)

ukAum.label: Assets managed by UK investment managers
ukAum.asOf: 2025, up 11% on 2024; about 53% for clients overseas
ukAum.source: Investment Association survey (reported by Investment Week, MarketsMedia)

mpc.label: How often the Monetary Policy Committee sets Bank Rate
mpc.asOf: nine members vote; decisions are published with the minutes

qeStock.label: Gilts still held under quantitative easing
qeStock.asOf: September 2026, down from a peak of £895 billion around the start of 2022; the Bank plans to unwind the rest by about 2034
qeStock.source: Bank of England (Governor's letter to the Chancellor, September 2026)

giltYields.label: UK gilt yields at auction
giltYields.asOf: Debt Management Office auctions, 7–20 October 2026: longer loans paying higher yields
giltYields.source: UK Debt Management Office (via Newsquawk auction reports)

bailoutCost.label: Final cost of the 2008 UK bank rescues
bailoutCost.asOf: Office for Budget Responsibility estimate, October 2021 (a £35.5 billion loss on RBS, now NatWest, offset by gains elsewhere); total support at the peak was about £850 billion including guarantees (National Audit Office, 2009)
bailoutCost.source: Office for Budget Responsibility; National Audit Office

ringFencing.label: Ring-fencing threshold for UK banks' core deposits
ringFencing.asOf: in force since 1 January 2019: everyday banking kept separate from investment banking
